    StartersPudge's peanut butter and banana toastiesPeanut butter and banana grilled sandwiches on buttered white breadHow to make it8 slices of white bread40g soft butter4 tbsp crunchy peanut butter2 bananas, sliced2 tbsp honeyButter one side of every slice of bread.Turn over and spread half with peanut butter, top with banana and honey, then close with the other slices, butter side out.Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 3 minutes a side until golden.Cut into fish shapes with a cutter, or into triangles.Kauai pokeDiced tuna in soy and sesame on rice crackersHow to make it300g sashimi tuna, diced2 tbsp soy sauce1 tsp sesame oil2 spring onions, sliced1 red chilli, finely chopped1 packet rice crackersToss the tuna with soy, sesame oil, spring onion and chilli.Spoon onto rice crackers and serve straight away.North Shore garlic butter prawnsThe surfing day with Nani and DavidHow to make itAs written, serves 4Shell-on prawns fried hard in butter with a whole bulb of garlic, lemon and parsley, served over sticky rice with lemon wedges, island prawns truck style.Cut down the backs of 800g shell-on green prawns and devein, leaving the shells on.Toss with 2 tbsp plain flour, 1 tsp paprika and salt.Cook 300g sushi rice.Melt 80g butter with 2 tbsp oil and fry 12 chopped garlic cloves gently for 3 minutes until golden.Add the prawns and cook over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes, tossing, until pink.Finish with lemon juice and parsley and spoon over the rice.Spam musubiOhana means nobody gets left without one.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsLoco moco, patties over rice with gravySeared beef patties on jasmine rice under onion gravyHow to make it600g beef mince300g jasmine rice1 brown onion, sliced30g butter1 tbsp plain flour400ml beef stock4 eggsShape the mince into patties and sear in a hot pan. Cook through.Cook the rice.In the same pan, soften the onion in butter, stir in the flour and then the stock until thick.Fry the eggs. Serve patties on rice with gravy and a fried egg.Nani's luau slow-roast kalua porkLilo, Nani and Stitch all around the tableHow to make itAs written, serves 4Smoky pork shoulder slow-roasted in banana leaves until it falls apart, with coconut rice, pineapple salsa and a crunchy cabbage slaw.Rub a 2kg pork shoulder with 1 tbsp sea salt and 1 tsp smoked paprika, wrap in banana leaves or foil and roast in a covered dish at 150°C for 5 hours until it pulls apart.Shred in the juices.Cook 300g jasmine rice with 270ml coconut milk and 250ml water.Dice half a pineapple with red onion, chilli, coriander and lime for salsa.Toss shredded cabbage with lime and sesame oil.Serve all together.SweetsExperiment 626 pineapple soft serveFrozen pineapple and coconut cream blended into dairy free soft serveHow to make it500g frozen pineapple100ml coconut cream1 lime, juiced1 tbsp caster sugarBlitz the pineapple with the coconut cream, lime juice and sugar until thick and smooth.Pipe into cups and serve straight away before it melts.DrinksBlue Hawaiian mocktailPineapple, coconut cream and blue raspberry cordial blended slushy, no alcoholHow to make it500ml pineapple juice150ml coconut cream60ml blue raspberry cordial3 cups ice4 pineapple wedgesBlend the pineapple juice, coconut cream, cordial and ice until slushy.Pour into four tall glasses with a pineapple wedge.
